description: Repairs r-def-expr-sql/ddl-fk-actions: every ON DELETE / ON UPDATE ALTER failed, so no action ran. Asks what a parent DELETE and a parent key UPDATE do when the relationship is made through Database.CreateRelation with Attributes 0, 256 (update cascade), 4096 (delete cascade) and 4352 (both): for each variant parent Fp<i> (rows 1, 2) and child Fc<i> (10 -> 1, 11 -> 2) are created, the relation is appended and read back (Relations refreshed), parent row 1 is deleted and parent row 2 renumbered to 9, each with dbFailOnError and Errors, and both tables are read. Fixture r-fix-expr-sql-expr is opened on a writable fresh copy through DAO.DBEngine.120; each recordset reads Name, Type and Value of every field. Each statement is preceded by a marker (a DROP TABLE of a table that does not exist, which always fails), so DBEngine.Errors read after the statement shows that statement's own failure or the marker's, never an older one. Where Field Precision and Scale are read, the recordset is first positioned on its first row (MoveFirst) and DecimalPlaces is not read.
retentionNote: Designed r-fix-expr-sql probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
